The owning agent was run inline and wrote all five declared outputs under artefacts/M1-S02 and nothing outside it: the OnCall_Tool_EC External Credential, the OnCall_Tool SecuredEndpoint Named Credential, the Tier2_Webhook_Admin permission set, package.xml at version 67.0 and deploy-order.md. process_observations.observation: The human gate did its job in the right order: step:M1-S02 was approved before the runner claimed the step, and set-status running was accepted rather than refused, so no work began behind an open gate.

The build-scope permission-set checker earned its scope declaration: it read M1-S01's object and field files alongside this step's permission set in one tree, which is the only way the field-permission rows could be adjudicated at all.
The eleven-not-twelve field count was re-derived from the M1-S01 field files rather than trusted from the amendment prose, and Status__c is indeed the only one of the twelve carrying required=true.

The step's own UNVERIFIED note anticipated one unknown in the AuthHeader parameterValue (the grammar) but not the second one that actually blocks writing it: nothing in the plan, the 45 clarifications or requirement.md names the Setup parameter the API key is stored under.

The on-call tool's endpoint URL is bound nowhere in the build, although twenty-five clarifications were asked about the integration; Q25 settled the Named Credential's API name and the per-org portability rule but never the host itself.

The known PV-007 prose lag is now visible in the artefacts: inputs.deploy_order names two post-deploy human steps while the step's manual test (f) and M1-S05 together require three, so deploy-order.md was written to the wider set and carries five.

The Wave 10 persistence clause asks both agents to also write docs/reports/<agent-id>/<run_id>.{md,json}, and the invocation's write boundary confines this run to the build directory; the build-scoped pair was written and the repo-scoped pair was not.
The step is built and carries four automated acceptance tests plus a manual access review that no agent in this run executed.
